description: Scan an npm package WITHOUT installing it. NOTE: this downloads metadata and the tarball of the latest published version from the npm registry (network access). Also runs the offline IOC lookup for the given name (and exact version, if provided; the deep content scan always analyzes the latest published version).

version.description: Exact version for the offline IOC check (optional). The remote deep scan targets the latest published version regardless.

name: scan_npm_package
